articles.summary: – Lumvoa™ (veligrotug-vvze) approved by the FDA for thyroid eye disease (TED) on June 26, 2026, ahead of target PDUFA date and immediately launched in the U.S. – – Elegrobart, potentially the first subcutaneous autoinjector for the treatment of TED, on track for BLA submission Q1 2027 – Read More
